summary: Frontend E2E testing of new 'Historial de gastos operativos' CRUD inside Vehículo detail. All flows (Registrar, Ver, Editar, Eliminar) and validations (monto=0 / vacío) PASSED. Backend integration (POST/GET/PUT/DELETE /api/gastos-vehiculos) works correctly through the UI; KPIs (Gasolina/Repuestos/Mano de Obra/Total) update reactively after each operation.
critical_code_review_comments: Note: the route for Vehículos is /dashboard/equipos/vehiculos (not /dashboard/vehiculos as stated in the PRD). The sidebar link is correct. PRD wording could be tightened.

Vehiculos.jsx is ~360 lines and contains three modal subcomponents (VehiculoModal, GastoModal, GastoViewModal). Still acceptable, but consider extracting modals into /pages/vehiculos/ for maintainability if the file keeps growing.
Validation 'monto > 0' is enforced only on submit via toast; consider adding HTML5 min=0.01 + disabling submit button when invalid to give earlier feedback (UX nicety, not a bug).
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_Vehiculo_Gastos (with adquisición $10000) for testing because no vehicle existed for the admin. CLEANED UP afterwards via DELETE /api/vehiculos/{id}. The gasto created during the test was also deleted as part of the DELETE flow validation.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Vehículos page route = /dashboard/equipos/vehiculos. Detail page is rendered conditionally when a vehicle card is clicked (no separate route). data-testids used: vehiculos-page, vehiculo-new-btn, vehiculo-card-<id>, vehiculo-detail-page, gasto-new-btn, gasto-modal, gasto-form-categoria, gasto-form-monto, gasto-form-fecha, gasto-form-descripcion, gasto-form-submit, gasto-row, gasto-ver, gasto-editar, gasto-eliminar, gasto-view-modal, gasto-view-close. Delete uses window.confirm — listen for dialog and accept.
test_cases_executed: Click vehicle card opens detail page OK
Validation: monto=0 keeps modal open and does NOT create row OK
Validation: monto vacío blocked by HTML5 required OK
Create gasto (gasolina $150.50) → row appears, KPI Gasolina shows $150.50 OK
VER opens read-only modal with categoria/monto/descripcion correct, close works OK
EDIT preloads data, change to repuestos $275.00 → table reflects update OK
DELETE confirm → row removed, total decreases OK
